issue_context.title: add a new function `Assert` to do some assertions in test

review_comments: we can rely on `InTest` is always true when `//go:build intest`, or to make it more obvious, merge assert.go and intest.go into one file.

I prefer to leave it here. Some PR are trying to use `testing.Testing()` to replace `inTest` flag. Though this PR cannot merge because of some bazel bug now, but one day it should merge to master, it's a good way to make sure this place can be modified in right way.
We can still eliminated the Assert function in build phase at that time if we want. just to add a new flag `inRelease` when building a product version...

> Some PR are trying to use testing.Testing() to replace inTest flag

Do you expect Assert should be enabled for testing.Testing()? With the "intest" build tag Assert is no-op.

> just to add a new flag inRelease when building a product version...

makes me think intest and indebug/inrelease are two separate things and we wrongly share the same name.

> Do you expect Assert should be enabled for testing.Testing()? With the "intest" build tag Assert is no-op.

Yes，at that time intest flag may be removed.

> makes me think intest and indebug/inrelease are two separate things.

At that time, `inrelease` tag will be used to optimize some performance like `-O` in C, but it may not be very necessary because I don't think it has a very big performance affect.
